arguments.text: Brighton and Hove Albion FC are slight favourites against Nottingham Forest FC at 40%, though the model suggests a notably tight contest with both the draw and away win at 30%. The standout feature is a lean expectation of goals, with the model making under 2.5 significantly more likely than the league baseline at 65% versus 48%, backed by expected goals totals of just 1.02 and 0.95. The three most probable outcomes are all low-scoring: 1-0, 1-1 and 0-0 together account for 37% of the model's distribution.
arguments.suggested_bet_reason: The model prices under 2.5 goals at 65%, a significant 17-point departure above the league baseline of 48%.
